title: eludite.test.debug input
description: Debug tests (Test > Debug All Tests, Ctrl+R, Ctrl+A; the Test Explorer's Debug; Debug Tests, Ctrl+R, Ctrl+T): build first (the build gate of F5), then start a debugging session (brief 0028) named after the project, running the tests under the project's adapter: a Microsoft.Testing.Platform test application with `--server --client-port <port>` under netcoredbg (.NET) or eludite-dbg-mono (.NET Framework off Windows), eludite-host connecting back so results still flow; a VSTest project's testhost, which vstest.console starts paused, with netcoredbg attached to it (a brief 0027 attach); a Cargo package's test executable under lldb-dap with `--exact` filters and `--test-threads=1` (eludite.debug.start's `test: true`). A temporary function breakpoint on the first test of the set (`Namespace.Class.Method`, or `crate::module::test`) stops the session at the test's first line; it is deleted at that first stop. The tests must be of one project. Without `ids`, `filter` and `selection`, every test of `project` (Debug All Tests: of the first test project). The answer is the stop summary; continue with the eludite.debug.* commands, whose `session` is the summary's.

ids.description: Test ids, as eludite.test.discover and eludite.test.results list them (`<project>|<runner id>`).

filter.description: Which tests: a case-insensitive substring of the fully qualified name (`CalculatorTests.Adds`, `tests::adds`), or a trait `Name=Value` (`Category=Math`). The Test Explorer's search box takes the same text after `FullName:` or `Trait:`.

project.description: A test project or Cargo package: its name as the Test Explorer shows it (`Corpus.XunitV3`, `Corpus.XunitV3 (net472)` for one target framework of a multi-targeted project, a Cargo package such as `corpus-tests`), or the path of its project file or Cargo.toml (absolute, or relative to the solution or workspace folder). Omitted: every test project and package.

framework.description: Only the containers of this target framework, for multi-targeted test projects (`net8.0`; brief 0049). Default: the Target Framework list's choice for a multi-targeted project when one was made (eludite.solution.select_configuration), else every framework.

selection.description: Debug Tests (Ctrl+R, Ctrl+T): the tests under the Test Explorer's selected node, else the test whose declaration is nearest above the active editor's caret.

wait_ms.description: How long to wait for the build, the launch and the first stop, in milliseconds. From the UI the command never waits; from another thread (an agent) the default is 30000.

depth.description: As eludite.debug.snapshot: levels of the locals to expand in the stop summary (1 to 5, default 1).
